explanation: The value is nonzero only at D1, when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent has been choosing a1, mostly in the first ~30 trials of the episode: the first rewarded D1 after an unrewarded trial is about 10, and each further rewarded D1 in a row drops by about 2-3 (10, 8, 6, 4, ...). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after no reward, when the agent is choosing a2, and almost always after trial ~30 (late in the episode a rewarded D1 sometimes reaches about 3).
